_comment: Deliberate exceptions for scripts/preflight.mjs. Every entry needs a reason, and the reason has to be evidence — the whole point of the check is that this class of fault looks fine right up until the phone refuses to launch.
_provenCommit: The last commit whose build was INSTALLED AND OPENED on a real phone. Native versions unchanged since here are trusted, because a launching build is the only proof that a module's symbols resolve against this SDK's core. MOVE THIS FORWARD only after a build from the new commit has actually been opened — never because it merely built.
_provenNote: 057c023 is build 28 (1.3.0) — installed from TestFlight on 10.08 and used for days, which is what makes expo-image-picker 56.0.16 and expo-image-manipulator 56.0.17 trusted: the owner opened it, picked a photo from her library and reported back on how it looked, so the picker and the manipulator both genuinely ran. It replaced 712b43b (build 26), which proved expo-media-library 56.0.6 and expo-notifications 56.0.16.
_runtimeHeldAt: The runtime version app.json is allowed to keep while `version` moves ahead of it. Apple requires a HIGHER CFBundleShortVersionString for every submission, but the runtime version decides which INSTALLED BUILDS can receive an update, so it must only move when an update genuinely NEEDS native code that older builds lack. HELD AT 1.3.0 SINCE 01.09, and deliberately still held on 20.09 even though the native side HAS moved: this round is Swift inside the widget extension only — new artwork rules and more detail on three tiles — and nothing in JS calls into any of it, so a bundle built from this source runs identically on a binary with the new Swift and on one without. test-widget-contract passing is the evidence: no field was added to the snapshot, so there is no newer JS sending something an older extension cannot decode. MOVING IT WOULD COST SOMETHING REAL — build 61 is the App Store binary on every public phone and listens on 1.3.0, so a runtime at 1.4.2 would cut every one of them off from OTA updates for no gain. Move it only when an update would actually break on an older binary.
_newerThanSdk: Packages deliberately newer than the version this Expo SDK ships. Only needed for packages that ALSO changed since provenCommit.
_entitlements: iOS entitlements the provisioning profile genuinely carries. Empty was correct until 01.09: build 15 died on com.apple.developer.applemusic and build 24 on aps-environment, both because the profile had no matching capability. The App Group below is here because the owner registered group.com.driftlore.CruiseFM on the Apple Developer site and ticked it on the app ID com.driftlore.CruiseFM — this list is the record of what Apple's side is expected to carry, so it moves only when that has actually happened.
_permissions: Info.plist *UsageDescription keys beyond the two the app needs for Apple Music and saving a share card.
_permissionsNote: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription is added by expo-dev-client's config plugin, not by us. It shipped in build 23, which Apple approved, so it is not a blocker — but expo-dev-client has no business in a store binary and dropping it from dependencies is worth doing at a quiet moment, not mid-release.
_permissionsNote2: NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription arrives with 1.3.0, for choosing your own photo as a custom station's background (expo-image-picker). Kept deliberately even though PHPicker on modern iOS runs out of process and probably does not require it: a missing string means a crash the first time someone taps Add a photo plus another build cycle, while a needless one costs a listing line that a visible button explains. Note it was ABSENT until 09.08 because expo-media-library's photosPermission:false was deleting the key expo-image-picker sets — see the checklist. If the first 1.3.0 build proves the picker works without it, removing it is a one-line change and this entry goes with it.
